taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-03, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 193.6 | 0.90 | 0.90
2 | 129.1 | 3.18 | 4.08
3 | 29.1 | 0.79 | 4.87
4 | 29.8 | 26.64 | 31.51
5 | 165.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-03, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station H-03, Survey Area H**

The interpreted VES model shows five layers. Resistivity decreases from a resistive surface layer (193.6 Ω·m) through a second layer (129.1 Ω·m) to a low-resistivity third layer (29.1 Ω·m) at 4.87 m depth. Resistivity then rises slightly in layer 4 (29.8 Ω·m, base at 31.51 m) and increases markedly in the underlying layer 5 (165.4 Ω·m), interpreted as the basement or a more resistive unit.

Applying the curve-type convention to the four resistivity transitions: layers 1-2-3 give Q (r1>r2>r3), layers 2-3-4 give H (r2>r3<r4), and layers 3-4-5 give A (r3<r4<r5), yielding QHA. This matches the on-file classification, so no correction to the curve-type label is required.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
